subject: Retention stitching: deletion/restore window & backup purge plan
messages:
From: Jennifer Hsu <jennifer.hsu@blueriverhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Alvarez <marco.alvarez@cloudops.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T14:12:00Z
Subject: Initial: retention requirements and purge timeline request

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this — BlueRiver Health is finalizing our vendor retention matrix for PHI-adjacent logs and backups. Two areas we need Redwood to confirm before legal will sign the amendment:

1) Backup snapshot retention: we need snapshots for a minimum of 90 days for patient-related datasets.
2) Temporary restore window: ability to restore a full snapshot for up to 30 days after a customer-initiated preservation request (we call these "restore windows").
3) Backup purge timeline & notice: what is your monthly purge cadence, and can you pause a scheduled purge for a specific customer if an audit/legal hold is initiated?

Also please include a current subprocessor list for storage/backup components and an inventory mapping of snapshot IDs to region (we need this for our SOC review). Attaching the draft DPA retention schedule (PDF) and our snapshot inventory template (CSV).

Appreciate a short summary of options (default behavior + exception/bridge path) and whether this requires a billing addendum.

Best,
Jennifer Hsu
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
BlueRiver Health

Attachments: BlueRiver_DPA_Retention_Schedule.pdf (pdf), backup-snapshot-inventory.csv (csv)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jennifer Hsu <jennifer.hsu@blueriverhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: retention requirements and purge timeline request

Jennifer — thanks for the clear ask and the templates. High level summary from our side:

- Default retention model:
  - Object backups/snapshots: 60 days retention (default), monthly snapshot purge cadence.
  - Operational logs/traces: 30 days standard retention, can be lengthened for customers with contracts.

- What you asked for: 90-day snapshot retention + 30-day restore window. We can support both, but this is outside our default tier and will be handled as a retention exception (billing addendum + operational runbook).

Proposal ("retention stitching" / bridge path):
  1) Short-term bridge (pilot): Redwood will retain BlueRiver snapshots for 90 days for a 6-month pilot period; after pilot, we can evaluate a permanent contract amendment.
  2) Restore window behavior: when BlueRiver requests a preservation/restore, Redwood will mark snapshots as preserved and keep them for an additional 30 days; restores during that window will be supported from preserved snapshots.
  3) Purge pause: we can pause a scheduled purge for a customer with 48 hours' notice and a completed preservation request; for legal holds we require a documented request from your legal team and coordination with our ops team.

Next steps I propose: Kimberly (cc) will outline the operational steps and exception runbook. Priyom, would you confirm whether we need an escrow-style export for long-term archival if BlueRiver wants beyond 180 days?

If this is agreeable we can prepare a short amendment to the DPA (retention carveout + ops appendix) and route it to DocuSign. I dropped a link to our sample runbook and a place-holder HubSpot deal in the related links.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Quoted message below from Jennifer Hsu:

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Jennifer Hsu <jennifer.hsu@blueriverhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial: retention requirements and purge timeline request

Jennifer / Avery — adding operational detail here so legal can see concrete steps. Summary of runbook items and operational constraints:

1) Snapshot retention and purge cadence:
   - Current infra default: daily snapshot policy; snapshots are consolidated & purged on a monthly maintenance window (second Wednesday of each month, 02:00–04:00 UTC).
   - Exception process: for customers with a retention carveout, we set a policy flag that excludes snapshots from the monthly purge for the duration of the carveout. Flagging is a single API call and an ops ticket to our backup service team.

2) Preservation / restore window:
   - When BlueRiver creates a preservation record, backups are moved to a preserved namespace and retained for the requested restore window (we support 7/14/30/90-day options). For your ask, we'll default to 30 days.
   - Restores are executed from preserved snapshots via our restore workflow; SLA for a full snapshot restore is 24–48 hours depending on size and region.

3) Purge pause & legal holds:
   - We can pause scheduled purges for specific customers with 48 hours' notice for operational holds and immediate pause for documented legal holds (legal hold requires signed request from customer's counsel).

4) Subprocessors + cross-border note:
   - Attached: subprocessor_list_20270802.csv (storage, backup orchestration, monitoring). Primary storage is AWS S3 in us-west-2 + replicated objects in us-east-1 for durability. Cross-border transfers: if you have EU residency constraints we will surface replication regions and discuss a regional-only policy.

5) Billing / long-term retention:
   - Extended retention (90 days or longer, or escrow exports beyond 180 days) will be billed as a retention addendum (monthly per-GB hold fee). We will draft estimates after we know dataset sizes for BlueRiver (please provide a rough GB count in the inventory CSV).

Attachments: backup-purge-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook stub), subprocessor_list_20270802.csv (csv)

Action items:
  - Jennifer: confirm you want the 30-day restore window and the 90-day snapshot retention for the pilot term (6 months).
  - BlueRiver ops: return inventory CSV with estimated sizes if possible.
  - Avery/Priyom: if BlueRiver wants an escrow export option, Priyom to confirm technical feasibility and estimated export time.

Kimberly Park
Director, Data Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kimberly — that level of detail helps. We confirm the following for the pilot:

- Snapshot retention: 90 days (pilot for 6 months).
- Restore window: 30 days preservation period per preservation request.
- Purge pause: we will submit legal hold requests when needed; 48 hours' operational pause is acceptable for now.

I will circulate a brief DPA amendment request to include the retention carveout language. Would you provide a redline-friendly clause for the DPA that we can attach? Also please include the estimated per-GB hold fee ballpark.

I'll send the inventory CSV (approx. 2.1 TB total) to the drive link you shared. For subprocessor clarity, please confirm whether any backup subprocessors are located outside the US and which of those process metadata vs content.

Jennifer Hsu
